senses.gloss:
मङ्क् मङ्क्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To go, Bhaṭṭ. 14, 10.
 2. † To adorn.
मङ्कुर मङ्कुर, m. A mirror; cf. मुकुर.

मङ्क्तृ मङ्क्तृ, i. e. मज्ज् + त्रि, m., f. त्री, and n.
 1. Bathing or drowning.
 2. Cleaning by immersion.

मङ्क्षु मङ्क्षु, ind. (= नक्षु),
 1. Quickly, instantly.
 2. Much, exceedingly.
मङ्क्षुण मङ्क्षुण, n. Armour for the thighs or legs.
मङ्ग मङ्ग, m. The head of a boat.

मङ्गल मङ्गल,
 I. adj. Lucky, propitious, Man. 2, 34; brave, Pañc. 8, 15.
 II. m. and n.
 1. Prosperity, welfare, Ṛt. 6, 34; bliss, Utt. Rāmac. 89, 4.
 2. Rejoicing, a festival, Pañc. 129, 17; solemnity, Vikr. d. 43 (सन्ध्या-, Evening service).
 3. Blessing, Daśak. in Chr. 201, 10; Sund. 2, 4; prayer, ib. 188, 22.
 III. m.
 1. The planet Mars.
 2. Burnt offering on various occasions of rejoicing.
 IV. f. ला.
 1. Umā, the wife of Śiva.
 2. A sort of bent grass, Panicum dactylon.
 V. n. Turmeric, Vikr. d. 53 (Sch.).
 --Comp.

मङ्गल्य मङ्गल्य, i. e. मङ्गल + य,
 I. adj., f. या.
 1. Auspicious, conferring happiness, Utt. Rāmac. 99, 1.
 2. Beautiful.
 3. Pious, pure, implying holiness, Man. 2, 31.
 II. m.
 1. The holy fig-tree, Ficus religiosa.
 2. A sort of pulse or lentils.
 III. n.
 1. Sour curds.
 2. Sandal.
 3. Red lead.
 4. Gold.
 5. Water brought from various holy places for the consecration of a king.
 IV. f. या. The name of several plants, Agallocum, etc.

माङ्गल्य माङ्गल्य, i. e. मङ्गल + य,
 I. adj. Portending good fortune, Śāk. d. 80.
 II. n.
 1. Prosperity.
 2. Festivity, festival, Utt. Rāmac. 154, 9.
मङ्गिनी मङ्गिनी, i. e. मङ्ग + इन् + ई, f. A boat.

† मङ्घ् मङ्घ्, i. 1, Par. To adorn.
 --i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To go.
 2. To begin moving.
 3. To begin.
 4. To move swiftly.
 5. To blame.
 6. To cheat.
† माङ्क्ष् मान्क्ष्, i. 1, Par. To desire.

माङ्गलिक माङ्गलिक, i. e. मङ्गल + इक,
 I. adj. Propitious.
 II. f. का, A proper name, Daśak. in Chr. 196, 16.
मङ्गल- + विधि मङ्गल- + विधि, m. the ceremony of oblations, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 6.
मङ्गलादेश- + वृत्त मङ्गलादेश- + वृत्त, i. e. मङ्गल-आदेश-, m. a fortune-teller, Man. 9, 258.
